User.title: User
User.description: Represents a student or university account with completely isolated profile data.

name.description: User full name or representative name

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last profile update

degree.description: Degree or program of study for students

department.description: Department or faculty for university representatives

interests.description: List of student career/academic domain interests

bookmarkedOpportunities.description: List of opportunity IDs saved by the student

appliedOpportunities.description: List of opportunity IDs applied to by the student

Opportunity.title: Opportunity
Opportunity.description: Represents an opportunity posted by a university or institution.

category.description: Category (Hackathon, Internship, Workshop, Competition, Scholarship, Fellowship, Other)

mode.description: Work/participation mode: Online, Offline, or Hybrid

createdBy.description: UID of the university user who posted it

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the opportunity was posted

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the opportunity was last updated

published.description: Whether the opportunity is published and visible to students

/users/{userId}.description: User profile collection storing student and university accounts.

/opportunities/{opportunityId}.description: Collection of published opportunities created and managed by universities.
